mapper.select: SELECT cm.id, cm.article_id, cm.user_id, u.nickname, u.avatar, cm.content, cm.parent_id, cm.create_time FROM comment cm LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = cm.user_id WHERE cm.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY cm.create_time ASC, cm.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (article_id, user_id, content, parent_id) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId})
